An image processing library bundled with Ghost contained a vulnerability in its SVG handling. Any staff user, including Contributors, could create a bookmark card for an attacker-controlled website, resulting in arbitrary commands being run on the Ghost server.

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v6.56.0 up to v6.65.0.

### Patches

v6.67.0 contains a fix for this issue.

### How to update

For self-hosters using Docker, find [Docker's official Ghost image here](https://hub.docker.com/_/ghost). Updating a Docker-based Ghost instance [is documented here](https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker#updating-ghost). 

If your Ghost is a Ghost-CLI install see our documentation on [updating it to the latest version here](https://docs.ghost.org/update). 

### References

We thank [Rafael B.](https://github.com/rafabd1) for disclosing this vulnerability responsibly.
